source.title: Constant Sub-second Cycling between Representations of Possible Futures in the Hippocampus

confidence_rationale: Direct, striking single-unit evidence that the hippocampus holds MULTIPLE competing future hypotheses in rapid alternation (~8 Hz, one per theta cycle) rather than collapsing to a single committed path. This is close to a one-to-one biological instantiation of the belief-state-hypothesis-set + provenance principle (INV-078: completed trajectory is a hypothesis, not a commitment). Strong source and tight mapping; transfer to non-spatial REE state the main caveat.
failure_signatures: Premature-collapse failure mode: if the hippocampus committed to one representation rather than cycling, it would model the 'hypothesis collapse too early / one bad explanation dominates' pathology; the healthy system instead maintains alternatives sub-second.
Hypothesis-proliferation has the opposite signature -- cycling without ever committing -- which the inference layer must bound (top-k).

mapping.source_claim_statement: At a choice point with two upcoming paths, hippocampal activity represents the two possible future scenarios in constant ~125-ms alternation (one scenario per theta cycle), so the animal holds multiple candidate futures concurrently rather than a single representation.
mapping.ree_translation: The clearest biology for MECH-385 (a bounded set of competing latent-state/trajectory hypotheses) and INV-078 (inferred trajectories remain provenance-tagged as hypotheses, not perception/commitment). Cycling-between-possible-futures = the substrate refusing to collapse uncertainty prematurely; it grounds both the belief-set representation and the safety principle that completed trajectories are proposals corrigible by outcome.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Two discrete spatial paths at a maze choice point is a much simpler hypothesis space than REE's general partial-observability state inference; the ~8 Hz theta-cycling mechanism is spatial-navigation-specific and should not be over-read as the literal implementation REE must adopt. The principle (hold competing futures, do not collapse early) transfers; the mechanism may not.
mapping.source_context: Rat dorsal CA1 ensemble recordings; W-track / multi-path maze choice points; theta-rhythm-locked analysis.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (Cell, Frank lab). Mapping fidelity is the highest in the pull -- competing-futures-without-collapse maps almost directly onto MECH-385 + INV-078. Transfer risk moderate (spatial binary choice -> general belief set).
